about: Full-stack developer focused on building complete products end to end: data model, backend, and the interface that connects them. My most recent project, similart, is a real-time multiplayer drawing game — the same stack that powers this site.
I'm particularly interested in work where backend and frontend are designed together from the start, not separately.

skills.backend: Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, Spring Boot, Java

projects.title: Similart
projects.problem: I wanted a project that combined real-time synchronization, image processing, and a game mechanic simple to explain but interesting to build.
projects.role: Solo full-stack design and development: architecture for the three backend services, real-time synchronization logic, and the full drawing interface in Angular.
projects.outcome: Fully playable end to end for 1 to 12 players, with reconnection, an admin panel, and a timed voting phase with a real countdown.
projects.cvBullet: Real-time multiplayer drawing game with % similarity scoring, for 1 to 12 players — Angular, Express, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL.

projects.title: This portfolio
projects.problem: I needed a portfolio built to get interviews, not just to look good.
projects.role: Full planning before writing any code: research into what recruiters actually look at, and performance decisions documented from day one.
projects.outcome: A 100% static site (Angular + JSON, no backend or database), prerendered and hosted on GitHub Pages — a complete, shareable technical roadmap, with every decision traceable to a concrete reason.
